title: Hancock's ayahuasca alien abduction vision

tellings.quote: then I saw not one but several flying saucers up above me and I saw this characteristic alien face you know this sort of heart-shaped large dark eyes

plain: The author Graham Hancock says that in 2003, after drinking ayahuasca, a psychedelic brew used by Amazon shamans, he had a vision outside a shaman's hut of being taken by aliens. He says he saw not one but several flying saucers above him, and the familiar alien face, heart-shaped with large dark eyes. He tells it as his own experience, and it raises the question of whether such visions touch something beyond the mind.
